answer: Sybil resistance holds when minting another identity costs more than that identity can extract. Require a fresh, non-reusable admission puzzle plus a refundable stake locked for several epochs before any payout. A farm hits its nadir once each extra head repeats that full cost -- every marble clone burns new work and capital -- while copied answers read as a recycled fable and get slashed, so the attacker's spend scales linearly and honest agents pay only once.
